title: Paperstory - a ode to Maplestory
author: OkCup2290
selftext:
Hey everyone!   
  
Here is a look at **Paperstory**, a 2D side-scrolling action RPG set inside a living manuscript where a creeping corruption called **The Rasure** is blotting out and rewriting classic stories and folklore (*Wonderland*, *Oz*, *The Pied Piper*, *The Bremen Town Musicians*, *Le Morte d'Arthur*, *The Princess and the Goblin*, and more).

https://reddit.com/link/1x978gp/video/j0sd24ft39wh1/player

Heavily inspired by Maplestory. 

6 classes with 3 schools each, so 18 paths.  


* **The Binder** (*Press · Bookend · Signature*)
   * Wields heavy bookbinding presses, iron bookend shields, and running thread. Stitch enemies together, haul whole packs across the floor into a single crush, or raise unbreakable bastions.
* **The Cutter** (*Silhouette · Patchworker · Trapwright*)
   * Fast-striking shear-wielders who slice along perforated seams. Trade places with shadow-stage decoys, unpick and steal enemy traits like fabric swatches, or lay spring-jaw clockwork snares that cut foes right out of the page.
* **The Folder** (*Menagerie · Latticework · Pleater*)
   * Martial origami masters who crease enemies with every blow and shift between *Crane*, *Frog*, *Fox*, and *Tortoise* forms. Summon flocks of paper cranes and living beasts, tessellate sacred grids across the ground, or snap concertina pleats into gale-force shockwaves.
* **The Postrider** (*Kitemaker · Relay · Pigeon Loft*)
   * High-mobility wind-runners who stamp foes with wax seals. Ride thermal updrafts on box kites, ricochet express letters between sealed targets, or call down homing flocks from the Pigeon Loft.
* **The Rubricator** (*Corrector · Censor · Copyist*)
   * Crimson-ink proofreaders who mark enemies with *Errata*—strikes, circles, and carets—then detonate them with *Stet*. Drop black-bar redaction seals, mend allies, or conjure illuminated scriptorium doubles that echo every cast.
* **The Inkwright** (*Poet · Typesetter · Signwright*)
   * Living-blot scriveners who compose three-part *Living Words*—*Fire* (Fervour), *Frost* (Calm Frost), and *Storm* (Arcane Inscription)—while absorbing incoming damage into their pigment pool with *Blotting Paper*.

The single player mode is fully built from tutorial > end game, bosses, equipment progression, upgrading equipments, jump quests and more.
